You can build a full home gym for $58, or about $150 for the complete setup. Here is every item I recommend, what it costs and why, with my Amazon links below.

Push-up handles ($10): https://link.amazon/B0emos3Rg
Jump rope ($9): https://link.amazon/B0eJr9bcV
Ab wheel ($17): https://link.amazon/B0iXeEzaz
35 lb kettlebell ($45): https://link.amazon/B0gYVYnnw
6 lb medicine ball (about $20): https://link.amazon/B0djLeNCQ
25 lb dumbbells ($29 a pair): https://link.amazon/B0cFPng9a

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

The basic setup (mat, push-up handles, jump rope, ab wheel) is $58 total. Add a kettlebell, medicine ball and dumbbells and the full setup is about $150. Keep everything cheap and basic: thin mat, simple handles, black iron kettlebell, plain dumbbells. Fancy versions do not work better.
